run_challenge_submission: run the script to create a NeurIPS 2021 Open Catalyst Challenge submission file from results
run_is2re_relaxations: run the script with --is2re-relaxations to write IS2RE results from trajectory files
run_hybrid_submission: run the script with --is2re-relaxations and --hybrid to write IS2RE results from S2EF prediction files
create_predictions_file: create a submission file by running the script with --path and --out-path arguments
review_write_is2re_relaxations: review the write_is2re_relaxations function that extracts energies from .traj files or hybrid S2EF predictions
